questions.question: What is some View in var body: some View?

answers.text: Any view at all, decided while the app runs
A specific view type that the compiler works out, without you having to spell it

questions.why: It is an opaque type: one concrete type, hidden behind the protocol.

questions.question: Which stack layers views on top of each other?
questions.why: Z is depth: front to back.

questions.question: Why does the order of modifiers matter?

answers.text: Each modifier wraps the view before it, so later ones apply to everything earlier

questions.question: What is the canvas in Xcode?

answers.text: The place where images are stored
